ready_gates.name: four_cell_failure_mode_comparison
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_adapter_failure_mode_comparison_v1_20260627 compared no-adaptation, scripted-feedback, and learned-residual policies across held-out full_low/empty_high and ordinary half_high/full_medium. Baselines failed only on object_accel_above_threshold and had final_feedback_trigger_count=0. Learned residual passed all four cells, first activated at 2.2666666507720947 s, had final_feedback_trigger_count=240, and reduced recorded max object acceleration by 5.679725200388358 to 7.839871912569344 m/s^2 against no-adaptation depending on the cell. This supports a current cup-benchmark stabilization-residual claim only.

This supports a narrow current cup-benchmark improvement claim, not broad object-family generalization or tactile/T-Rex equivalence.
